name: @goodandready/dsh-russian-lang
description: Russian localization for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.1.5-rc.2+) web UI: adds Русский as the native language option in Settings - General - Language. 100.0% coverage across 7,149 keys (1,225 core UI keys + 5,924 keys across 45+ ecosystem plugins) with zero machine drafts. Features unified dsh-clinebot visual design standard for Settings Card, official One-click plugin updater (/api/dsh-russian-lang/update), full translations for updated ecosystem plugins (dsh-lanmode, dsh-moa, dsh-gitea, dsh-issue-reporter, dsh-messenger-gateway, dsh-usage-guard, dsh-cron, dsh-model-search, dsh-agent-orchestrator, dsh-model-sync, Live Canvas, dsh-goal, Skills Manager, Shadow Auditor, Kanban Epics, Key Rotation, Remote Workspace, Cost Meter, Vision Bridge, Time Machine), Smart Russian UX (localized Markdown export, turn translation, live typography, slash command aliases, Alt+L layout fix), expanded error humanizer (POSIX, HTTP 4xx/5xx), and runtime snapshot extension without modifying core files.

scripts.check: python3 tools/lint_translations.py && python3 check-coverage.py && python3 tools/term_check.py --ci
scripts.test: node --test test/*.mjs && node test/_repro.cjs && python3 test/test_tools.py && python3 test/test_extract.py && python3 test/test_overflow.py
